reason: NONE. First thing I saw was 'Every batch lab-tested' with a QR code, and my gut said anyone can print that; I look for an NSF or USP seal and there isn't one. Brand new, zero reviews, and $1 a day is more than I pay per serving now, so I'm not switching my night routine to an unknown.
objection: Lab-tested by a lab I've never heard of isn't the same as NSF or USP certified, and with no reviews I have nobody else vouching for it. Also 200 mg per sachet at $30 is pricey per serving.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF Certified or USP Verified mark on the box, plus a few hundred real reviews, or a lower price for a first box.
